name: howto
title: How to give a gift that gets kept
sub: Five checks before you order, from the owner reports in this guide
footer: Sources: owner reports and expert pages named in this guide, October 2026. Return windows differ by store; check the one you use.

items.head: 1. Match the person
items.body: Cooks, pet owners, iPhone users: pick by habit, not by price.

items.head: 2. Check the variant
items.body: Dog weight for a KONG, iOS version for an AirTag, model for a throw.

items.head: 3. Buy from the brand
items.body: Owners report fakes and wrong items from marketplace sellers.

items.head: 4. Add the care note
items.body: Wash the Owala gasket weekly; hand-wash the Rubbermaid lids.

items.head: 5. Send the receipt
items.body: Wrong size is the top reason gifts come back (Axios, Dec 2025).
